name: Le Pavillon
dinnerNote: Three-course dinner menu (six-course tasting menus $165 and $205)
lunchNote: Two-course prix fixe lunch (three courses $95, six-course tasting $120)

menus.name: Three-course dinner menu
menus.note: Choice of starter, main course and dessert; some dishes carry a supplement (Dover sole $12, lobster $8, 30g caviar $165).

menus.name: Chefs' Tasting Menu
menus.note: Six courses including caviar spaghetti and Dover sole; six-course wine pairing $145.

menus.name: Tasting of Vegetables
menus.note: Six vegetable courses; six-course wine pairing $145.

alsoTry.name: Bar Vandy
alsoTry.note: Le Pavillon's own bar, with cocktails, wines by the glass and bar bites from about $18, at lunch and dinner.

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, or by phone.
cancellation: Guests running late have a 15-minute grace period; after that the restaurant seats them as best it can.
walkIns: The bar and lounge (Bar Vandy) serves cocktails, wine and bar bites Monday to Friday from 11:30am and Saturday from 5pm.
groups: Private events for up to 200, from the semi-private Garden Table among the olive trees (up to 14 guests) and a private dining room to buying out the whole restaurant. Enquire through the website or events@lepavillonnyc.com.
dressCode: Business casual is strongly recommended. No athletic or leisure wear, and men may not wear shorts or sandals in the dining room.
children: Pushchairs and prams cannot be accommodated in the restaurant.
byob: Corkage for up to two standard bottles not on the wine list, $150 a bottle.
